newsitem.title: CYPRUS: OPEC March output drops to 26.6 million bpd - MEES.
newsitem.headline: OPEC March output drops to 26.6 million bpd - MEES.

text.p: OPEC's crude oil output fell a modest 70,000 barrels per day (bpd) in March to 26.6 million bpd from 26.67 million bpd in February, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) said on Monday.
Lower production was mostly due to an estimated 250,000 bpd fall in Iranian output in March. MEES put Iranian production for the month at 3.451 million bpd against 3.702 million bpd in February.

"At this stage it cannot be assessed with any certainty whether the March decrease was due to problems on the marketing, production/export or logistical sides, or to some combination of all three," MEES said.

"However, it is noteworthy that liftings by Japanese customers registed a very sharp decline of 274,000 bpd in March, falling to 390,000 bpd as compared with 664,000 bpd in February and 864,000 bpd in January," it added.
MEES said the lower Japanese liftings accounted for more than 100 percent of the shortfall in Iran's March output.
Nigeria also registered lower production "where internal unrest disrupted Shell's production of Forcados and Bonny Light crudes in the second half of the month," MEES added.

"This resulted in an average loss of around 50,000 bpd in Shell's output for the month as a whole, part of which was made up by increased output from other ventures, leading to an overall drop of only around 30,000 bpd," it said.
The newsletter said Iran's crude exports, meanwhile, dropped 251,000 bpd in March to average 2.251 million bpd in the month, compared to 2.502 million bpd in February.
MEES said the fall in output in Iran and Nigeria were offset to a large extent by higher output among other OPEC members, mainly Iraq.

"Iraq's exports under the oil-for-food programme...rose to 680,000 bpd in March against 580,000 bpd in February, bringing total Iraqi production up to 1.25 million bpd in March, a gain of 100,000 bpd over the previous month," it said.
A Reuters survey of OPEC officials, oil companies and analysts put OPEC March output at 26.90 million bpd from 26.77 million in February.
